name: Turkey Tetrazzini
subtitle: By Emeril Lagasse
equipment: Large frying pan, 9×13 casserole or baking dish

items: 6 Tbsp unsalted butter (or use salted butter and add less salt later)
½ cup chopped red bell peppers
1 pound white button mushrooms, ends trimmed and sliced
½ tsp freshly chopped thyme leaves
¼ cup dry white wine (or just substitute more stock)
2 cups chicken stock or low-sodium canned chicken broth
12 ounces wide egg noodles, cooked in salted water until al dente, about 10 minutes
1 pound cubed or bite-size shredded roast turkey
¾ tsp freshly ground black pepper

steps.title: Prep the pan
steps.body: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Butter a 9×13 casserole or baking dish and set it aside.

steps.title: Saute the vegetables
steps.body: In a large frying pan, saute over high heat until soft, about 4 minutes: **6 Tbsp unsalted butter**, **1½ cups chopped onions** and **½ cup chopped red bell peppers**.

steps.title: Add the garlic
steps.body: Add **1 tsp minced garlic** and saute about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Add the mushrooms
steps.body: Add **1 pound white button mushrooms**, ends trimmed and sliced, **1½ tsp Essence** (recipe follows) and **½ tsp freshly chopped thyme leaves**. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the mushrooms have released their liquid, about 6 minutes.

steps.title: Add the flour
steps.body: Sprinkle over the mixture **¼ cup all purpose flour** and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Add the wine and stock
steps.body: Add **¼ cup dry white wine** (or just substitute more stock) and **2 cups chicken stock or low-sodium canned chicken broth**. Cook, stirring, until smooth and thick, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Add the cream and simmer
steps.body: Add **1¾ cups heavy cream**. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the sauce is thick enough to coat the back of a spoon and very flavorful, 15 to 20 minutes.

steps.title: Add the noodles and turkey
steps.body: Then add and stir until thoroughly combined: **12 ounces wide egg noodles**, cooked in salted water until al dente, about 10 minutes; **1 pound cubed or bite-size shredded roast turkey**; **1 Tbsp freshly chopped parsley leaves**; **1½ tsp salt**; **¾ tsp freshly ground black pepper**; and **⅓ cup freshly grated Parmesan**.

steps.title: Top the casserole
steps.body: Transfer to the buttered baking dish and top with **1 (5½ ounce) bag potato chips**, crushed.
